original_test_intent: Validate the complete SMBIOS Type 39 inventory and topology for every system power supply, including identity, capacity/characteristics and all referenced voltage/cooling/current handles, with persistence after reboot.
original_method: Preserve logs, collect complete Type 39 plus referenced Type 26/27/29 structures on the verified SUT, reconcile each supply to its physical slot/group and sensor/cooling topology against the owner recipe, reboot once with approval and repeat.
manual_activity: The owner supplies exact PSU population/topology, Type 39 values and referenced-handle map and approves reboot/recovery; automation remains read-only.
required_inputs: Exact chassis/PSU slot, group, serial/model/revision and redundancy topology
Expected Max Power Capacity, units and Power Supply Characteristics bit semantics
Expected Type 26 voltage, Type 27 cooling and Type 29 current handle mapping per PSU
Optional/unpopulated supply and unknown-handle policy plus identifier redaction
Approved reboot, workload/power window, boot deadline and independent recovery
safety_requirements: Preserve dmesg, syslog and SEL; no log clearing
Keep SMBIOS reads non-mutating and do not alter PSU, power, fan or thermal policy
Protect serial, asset and model identifiers in review copies
Reject missing/duplicate supplies, unresolved/wrong-type handles, invalid capacity units or topology mismatch
Require reboot approval and verify redundancy/recovery readiness
No automatic retry or inferred slot mapping
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, PSU topology, handle matrix and reboot approval
Collect complete Type 39 and referenced Type 26/27/29 structures
Resolve each supply and handle to physical/semantic identities and validate fields
Make no power/thermal mutation, retry or PASS/FAIL verdict
engineer_actions: Approve supply population, fields, capacity/characteristics and handle topology
Review inventory/topology/persistence deviations and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `dmidecode -t 39` is relevant, but `grep -A1` omits all declared fields and cannot resolve Type 26/27/29 handles or perform reboot persistence; transport is unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely archive complete Type 39 and referenced Type 26/27/29 structures before/after the approved reboot, then reconcile supply identity, capacity, characteristics and handle topology.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All thirteen Type 39 field groups, reboot persistence, source script and 5/5-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Normalize each Type 39 record by physical PSU slot/group, validate protected identity/capacity/characteristics, resolve its three referenced handles to the correct typed structures and compare the full set across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact PSU/handle topology and protected identity handling while rejecting filtered evidence, log clearing and power-policy changes.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A System Power Supply heading cannot expose a missing PSU, wrong slot/group, unrealistic capacity, incorrect characteristic bits or a handle that points to another supply's sensor.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS inventory does not prove live PSU output or redundancy behavior; those require separate active/hardware tests and cannot be claimed here.

project_override_considerations: Optional slots, shared cooling groups or absent probe handles must be allowlisted by exact chassis/BIOS recipe and remain visible; identity redaction cannot remove linkage needed for per-slot comparison.
expected_evidence: Verified chassis/PSU/BIOS/SMBIOS/dmidecode identity and approved Type 39/handle matrix
Complete pre/post raw Type 39 and referenced Type 26/27/29 records
Approved reboot timeline, same-target proof and topology persistence diff
Preserved logs, no power/thermal write, no-auto-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently target the complete Type 39 supply record and reboot persistence. DeepSeek is incomplete but not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: PSU topology/handle matrix and reboot approval are normal inputs; they gate execution but not static review.

review_improvement: Preserves all Type 39 fields and adds per-slot physical identity plus typed Type 26/27/29 handle resolution without turning metadata validation into a power test.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 39 contains a graph of supply-to-probe/cooling relationships. A numeric handle that exists is insufficient if it resolves to the wrong structure type or another PSU's sensor. Capacity and characteristics also require decoded units/bits, while identity comparison needs controlled serial linkage. Therefore complete cross-structure topology—not a header—is the minimum auditable evidence, and it still cannot claim live power performance.
